# GenericSpinChainShowBasis

Module: **Spin** · directory: `Spin/src/Programs` · binary: `Spin/src/Programs/GenericSpinChainShowBasis`

Manual: [GenericSpinChainShowBasis (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/GenericSpinChainShowBasis.md)

```text
GenericSpinChainShowBasis, version 0.01

Usage: GenericSpinChainShowBasis [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -s, --spin : twice the spin value (default value = 1)
    -p, --nbr-spin : number of spins (default value = 10)
    -z, --sz-value : twice the value of sz (default value = 0)
    --fixed-parity : the spin chain has a fixed total parity
    --doubled-spinchain : use the double spin chain HilbertSpace
    --staggered : use the double spin chain HilbertSpace
    --parity : parity of the spin chain (default value = 0)
    --periodic-chain : consider periodic instead of open chain
    --no-sz : don't consider sz quantum number (only available for certain chains up to now)
    --max-momentum : max momentum in the periodic case (should be a divisor of the number of sites) (default value = -1)
    --sz-symmetry : set the Sz<->-Sz symmetry sector (0 if it should not be used) (default value = 0)
    --inversion-symmetry : set the inversion symmetry sector (0 if it should not be used) (default value = 0)
    --zero-half : consider the 0 +1/2 spin chain
    --symmetry : use Hilbert space with ZZ symmetry in the case of the 0+1/2 doubled chain
    --zket : value of the Z operator in the ket layer (default value = 0)
    --zbra : value of the Z operator in the bra layer (default value = 0)
    --sublatticeQN : use Hilbert space with sublattice quantum numbers (implies the use of ZZ symmetry) in the case of the 0+1/2 doubled chain
    --sket : value of the Sublattice QN in the ket layer (default value = 0)
    --sbra : value of the Sublattice QN the bra layer (default value = 0)
    --sproduct : value of the product of the Sublattice QNs (default value = 0)
    -k, --momentum : momentum sector (for periodic chain) (default value = 0)
    -e, --state : name of the file containing the eigenstate to be displayed
    --complex-vector : the eigenstate to be  displayed is a complex vector
    --save-normalized-vector : Save the phase-fixed vector for eigenvectors of PEPS transfer matrix
    --unnormalize : remove the symmetry factors from the basis (i.e. the sqrt(orbit size) factors)
    --hide-component : hide state components (and thus the corresponding n-body state) whose absolute value is lower than a given error (0 if all components have to be shown (default value = 0)

output options:

tools options:

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
